usedFor: monday.com holds boards, items and subitems, and Google Docs receives the text through “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “Item Moves to a Group” in monday.com, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: A move between groups marks progress on an item, and the action writes it into a document tab.

watchOut: “New Item Added to Board” in monday.com is polling, so the document tab updates after a scheduled check.
